image_prompt: A surreal, slightly humorous photograph. A single, elegant black high-heeled shoe is perfectly placed on top of a majestic, snow-capped mountain peak, as if preparing to be worn by the mountain itself. The shoe is sparkling clean, reflecting the crisp, clear blue sky. The text "O sapato serve para calçar." is subtly integrated into the scene, perhaps etched into a small, polished stone at the base of the shoe, or floating as a transparent thought bubble above it. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the contrast between the delicate shoe and the rugged landscape.
caption:
Revelação bombástica do dia: O SAPATO SERVE PARA CALÇAR! 
Quem imaginaria, né? Às vezes, as maiores verdades estão bem debaixo do nosso nariz (ou dos nossos pés!). Qual item do dia a dia tem uma função tão óbvia que chega a ser genial? #SapatoParaCalçar #ObviedadesDoCotidiano #ModaEVerdades #PensandoForaDaCaixa #Humor #VerdadesSimples
